answer: Every identity posts a 70-credit bond and claims one distinct grove plot in the haven ledger under its key; that plot then lies fallow for two epochs. An island auditor checks each claim, and a reused or still-fallow plot forfeits the bond. Each fake needs its own plot, bond and 25 plot fee, so the 1,000th fake still pays 95, and 1,000 fakes post 70,000 in bonds and pay 25,000 in fees, with no reuse. An honest agent pays 95 once and reclaims its bond after one clean epoch. A plot-rental ring fails: a rented plot either mismatches its key or is still fallow, so the auditor destroys the bond.
